sentences.en: The road tends to the south at the next village.
sentences.zh: 在下一个村庄，这条路将向南走。

sentences.en: I saw a lot of birds flying toward the south.
sentences.zh: 我看到很多鸟飞向南方。

sentences.en: I experienced intense cold at the South Pole last year.
sentences.zh: 去年我在南极经历了强烈的寒冷。
